editorial:
Ever feel like you are in a love triangle, but it is actually a love square where nobody is on the same page? That is exactly what you get here. You meet Juliette, who is totally head over heels for Bruno, but he is too busy chasing Corinne to even notice. Meanwhile, Corinne is just doing her own thing, having a secret fling with Luc. The real twist is that Luc is actually in love with Bruno and is terrified to tell him. It is a messy, emotional ride that feels like a bunch of people talking past each other while their hearts are breaking in different directions.

You will probably love how the actors make these awkward moments feel so real. The pacing is a bit slow, which fits the moody vibe, but it keeps you guessing about who will end up with whom. If you enjoy character studies that feel like real life, you should definitely give this a try. Since it is an older gem, you might want to track down the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the details clearly, or just look for a high-quality rental on Apple TV for a cozy movie night.
endingExplained: Everything boils over when the secrets finally come out. The tension between the four friends reaches a breaking point, and the hidden feelings are laid bare. You see that the cycle of longing and lying only leads to pain. Instead of a happy fairytale ending, the movie wraps up with a feeling of sadness and realization. The characters end up emotionally exhausted, proving that keeping secrets from the people you love usually ends in a total crash.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves complex relationship dramas and emotional storytelling.
